Subject: Tighten pipeline gaps — EMEA & APAC short sprint (finance lock Aug 31)

Team —

We need a short, focused sweep to close stage gaps and lock commits ahead of Finance's cutoff on Aug 31. Goal: reduce late-stage uncertainty and make sure anything we plan to include in the August close is documented with a clear owner and blockers.

What I need from each owner by EOD Aug 24 (48 hours):
- Update each opportunity row in the attached pipeline_gap_template.xlsx: current stage, expected close date, probability (confidence %), ARR/ACV, and primary blocker (PO/Legal/Tech/None).
- If a PO/contract is pending, attach the latest contract snippet or point to the Drive link.
- For any conversion that requires finance input (multi-country billing, revenue recognition concerns), flag it in the "Finance Flag" column and ping Naomi.

Quick priorities:
1) Accounts with verbal commits but missing POs or signed contracts — push for dates or move to "Best Effort" if not confirmed.
2) Deals > $75k ARR that are listed as commit — must have an owner and a single next step (e.g., PO expected, legal review).
3) APAC deals that require regional billing agreements — include the procurement contact and status.

I attached a clean template to simplify the rollup; I want one consolidated CSV back from Mina by EOD Aug 25. Vanessa — please call out any accounts you believe need escalation. Mina — can you own the consolidated snapshot? Naomi — FYI for finance flags and any revenue recognition queries.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Naomi — forwarding the snapshot and flags from Mina. Summary for Finance:
- Acme EU (Sara Müller) — Waiting PO, potential Aug 29 PO date, contract exception in progress (attached). If PO arrives by Aug 29, we expect to include in Aug close; otherwise move to Sept.

Thanks for the clear rollup, Kim & Mina. Finance guidance below: 

- Acme EU: We need a valid PO and an executed contract (signed by both parties) in order to recognize revenue in the August close. If you only have a PO without an executed signature by Aug 31, we'll classify it as "post-close" and include it in September. Please escalate for signature — Naomi (Legal) needs the executed PDF.

- Infratech: For now, we can hold to the EMEA billing entity only if the customer confirms the EMEA entity and billing address prior to cutoff. If confirmation arrives later, we'll need to move recognition to the month it is confirmed. Cross-border booking without the right entity details will create reconciliation overhead; avoid unless procurement confirms.

- Smaller accounts: Mark as "Best Effort" and exclude from commit totals unless PO+contract are present.

I'll make a note in the August close pack with these rules. If any deal > $100k faces an exception, loop me directly and we'll escalate to revenue ops to evaluate one-off treatments.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
